name: tencent/hunyuan-3d/3.1/pro/image-to-3d
description: Hunyuan 3d 3.1 Pro by Tencent - convert 2D images into 3D models with AI. Generate textured 3D assets from single photos for games, AR/VR, e-commerce, and digital content creation.

image.title: Input Image Url
image.description: Front view image URL. Resolution: 128-5000px, max 8MB, formats: JPG/PNG/WEBP. Tips: simple background, single object, object >50% of frame.

top_image.title: Top Image
top_image.description: Optional top view image URL for multi-view reconstruction.

back_image.title: Back Image
back_image.description: Optional back view image URL for multi-view reconstruction.

enable_pbr.title: Enable PBR
enable_pbr.description: Generate PBR materials (metallic, roughness, normal). Ignored for Geometry output.

face_count.title: Face Count
face_count.description: Target polygon face count (custom face count is billed as an add-on).

left_image.title: Left Image
left_image.description: Optional left view image URL for multi-view reconstruction.

right_image.title: Right Image
right_image.description: Optional right view image URL for multi-view reconstruction.

bottom_image.title: Bottom Image
bottom_image.description: Optional bottom view image URL for multi-view reconstruction.

generate_type.title: Generate Type
generate_type.description: Normal: textured model. Geometry: geometry-only white model.

left_front_image.title: Left Front Image
left_front_image.description: Optional left-front view image URL for multi-view reconstruction.

right_front_image.title: Right Front Image
right_front_image.description: Optional right-front view image URL for multi-view reconstruction.

id.description: Unique identifier for the generation task.

error.description: Error message if the task failed. Empty on success.

model.description: Model ID used for the prediction.

status.description: Status of the task: pending, running, completed, failed, or timeout.

url.description: The URL where the generated content can be downloaded from.

content_type.description: The MIME type of the output file.

outputs.description: Array of generated content. Empty when status is not completed.

readme:
# Hunyuan 3D 3.1 Pro Image to 3D

Hunyuan 3D 3.1 Pro turns an image (plus up to six extra views) into a high-detail textured or geometry-only 3D model.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `image` | image URL, required | — | Front view. JPEG, PNG, or WebP URL. |
| `top_image` | image URL | — | Optional extra view. |
| `back_image` | image URL | — | Optional extra view. |
| `enable_pbr` | boolean | false | PBR materials. |
| `face_count` | integer 40000–1500000 | — | Target face count. |
| `left_image` | image URL | — | Optional extra view. |
| `right_image` | image URL | — | Optional extra view. |
| `bottom_image` | image URL | — | Optional extra view. |
| `generate_type` | `Normal` / `Geometry` | `Normal` | `Normal` textured, `LowPoly`, or `Geometry` (untextured). |
| `left_front_image` | image URL | — | Optional extra view. |
| `right_front_image` | image URL | — | Optional extra view. |

## Billing

$0.375 per model; PBR, a custom face count, and extra views each add $0.15.

| Request | Price |
|---|---|
| Default | $0.375 |
| With PBR | $0.525 |
| With custom face count | $0.525 |

Failed runs are not charged.

## Also on SandBase

Other Hunyuan 3D endpoints: `tencent/hunyuan-3d/3.1/pro/text-to-3d`, `tencent/hunyuan-3d/3.0/image-to-3d`.
